title: PagerArchive network profile
description: Rules that apply to every page on one paging network (SPEC.md section 6.3). Patterns use RE2 syntax (ADR 0001).

priority_markers.description: Two-character text prefixes and the priority each one means. Case-sensitive.

ignored_capcodes.description: Capcodes or ranges whose pages are dropped and never stored.

heartbeat_capcodes.description: Capcodes or ranges whose pages are network heartbeats.

redaction_rules.description: Applied in order. Each match is replaced by one REDACTED; if the pattern has a group named redact, only that group is replaced. A rule that alters one of its own must_not_match examples is an error.

job_number_patterns.description: Tried in order on every page when its format extracts no job_number. The first match is the job number.

deployment_code_pattern.description: Optional. Finds a code in a page that opens a large event (R87), such as one naming a pre-formed group of appliances sent together. Every match in the text a pager displays is a code; with a group named code, that group is. With no pattern, only a job with enough Emergency pages opens large events.

fireground_channel_pattern.description: Optional (R92a). Finds the fireground channels a page names, in the text a pager displays. Every match counts; with a group named number, that group is the number, else the whole match. A number that isn't all digits gives no link; leading zeros are ignored. With no pattern, no page links to the radio.

event_categories.description: Report categories. A code ending in * matches by prefix. Unmapped codes count as Other.

address_dataset.description: The local address dataset used for address_split and geocoding. path is relative to this file.

grid_reference.description: How grid references are read (R25). mgrs-6-digit-in-locality-square: 3 digits of easting then 3 of northing (100 m), completed from the UTM zone and 100 km square containing the page's locality.

street_types.description: Street type spellings and the abbreviation they normalise to, e.g. STREET: ST.

areas.description: Optional. Layers of named polygons a located page can fall in, outlined on the map (R88), in the order they're shown; a page can be in one area of each layer. Each layer: id is its machine name, unique here; path is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Polygon and MultiPolygon features in WGS84 longitude and latitude, relative to this file; label is shown before each name ("District" makes "District 08"); name_property is the feature property holding each one's name; attribution is shown on the map; outline is how the map draws it (solid, dashed or dotted; by default the first layer solid, the second dashed, the third dotted). Changing them re-parses no pages.
